name: Defect register — PR review sweep
description: Run on a schedule. Finds defect-register PRs with review feedback nobody has answered, and starts one responder run per PR.

parameters.name: stateDir
parameters.description: The pipeline's working folder, shared across its runs: backlog, triage verdicts, ranked.md, fixes.

parameters.name: prAuthor
parameters.description: The GitHub login the pipeline opens PRs as; its replies count as answers.
